arm_note: Local EraVM arm of CSI-CHAIN-LOCAL-01 (CHAIN-PROTOCOL-v1 section 15.1 amendment A6 and section 16). It has its own binding, image, lockfile, output roots and baseline tag. The L1 arm (binding CSI-CHAIN-LOCAL-01.json) is frozen at chain-l1-baseline-20260925 and is not changed by this arm; L1 is reproduced from that tag.
measurement_paths_note: tracked_paths: clean-tree check before a run. measurement_paths: everything that can change a measured value; used for the baseline-tag and record checks. The L2 image records (adapters/eravm/IMAGE.json, ARCHIVE.json) are checked separately against the image actually used.
measurement_code_paths_note: The EraVM measurement implementation: contracts, frozen inputs, the reused workload modules and chainbench libraries that the adapter loads, the adapter (libraries, runner, validation and comparison scripts, lockfile, pins, image recipe, in-container dispatcher). Host orchestration, documentation, records and this binding are not part of it.

commit_semantics.measurement_code_commit: the commit at which the packaged L2 dry run validated the EraVM measurement implementation; measurement_code_paths must be byte-identical between it and baseline_commit
commit_semantics.baseline_commit: the commit of the annotated L2 baseline tag (chain-l2-baseline-*); the scientific L2 runs are launched from it with a clean tree
commit_semantics.registry_commit: the L1 row of csi/campaign-index.csv is unchanged; an L2 registry entry is added only when the scientific L2 run exists

reference_dry_run.note: accepted packaged L2 dry run at 3e0f6c8 with the archived image (raw data on the author's machine only; git-ignored; records in csi/campaigns/chain/CSI-CHAIN-LOCAL-01/l2/readiness/)
